1.name: 32kHz
1.hint: open-drain 32.768 kHz output: needs an external pull-up when used, may be left open

2.name: VCC

needs.source: Maxim Integrated DS3231 Extremely Accurate I2C-Integrated RTC/TCXO/Crystal, 19-5170 Rev 10 (3/15), p. 9 Pin Description: VCC 'should be decoupled using a 0.1µF to 1.0µF capacitor'
needs.why: 0.1 µF to 1.0 µF; judged on the capacitors layout.near places next to the part, else on the net's sum – on a rail with more capacitance place the decoupling next to the DS3231 in layout.near

2.hint: if VCC is not used, connect it to ground

3.name: INTSQW
3.hint: INT/SQW, active-low open-drain: pull-up to a supply of at most 5.5 V, regardless of VCC; at power-up an interrupt output with alarms disabled; may be left unconnected

4.name: RST
4.hint: active-low open-drain reset output and debounced pushbutton input; internal 50 kΩ (nominal) pull-up to VCC – the datasheet says no external pull-up should be connected

needs.source: Maxim DS3231 19-5170 Rev 10 (3/15), pin description RST: 'It has an internal 50kΩ nominal value pullup resistor to VCC. No external pullup resistors should be connected.'

14.name: VBAT
14.hint: backup supply: as backup source no capacitor is required; as primary source decouple with 0.1 µF to 1.0 µF low-leakage; if VBAT is not used, connect it to ground

needs.source: Maxim DS3231 19-5170 Rev 10 (3/15), pin description VBAT: 'When using the device with the VBAT input as the primary power source, this pin should be decoupled using a 0.1µF to 1.0µF low-leakage capacitor'

I2C fast mode up to 400 kHz
